name: segmented-control
summary: A liquid indicator that stretches as it slides; drag it to scrub.
props: Segments. `icon` can be a node or ({ active, color }) => node.
Controlled selection (or use defaultValue; defaults to the first segment).
Raised pill on a track, tab underline, or tinted outline.
Equal-width segments filling the row, or segments sized to their labels.
Indicator colour (pill becomes a filled accent pill).
Style for the track holding the segments.
behavior: The leading edge of the indicator springs ahead and the trailing edge catches up, so it stretches as it travels. Labels squish on press and bounce when selected.
A sideways drag that starts on the selected segment scrubs across the others; drags that start elsewhere are left to a parent ScrollView. Short segments get hitSlop up to 44pt.
A selection tick plays on each change (haptics, on by default).
A tablist of tabs with selected and disabled state, labelled by each option's label or accessibilityLabel.
